title: The City Repeats 100 Minutes But People Keep Aging | ECHO//30 Ep. 9
description:
Kavi and Tara emerge inside Central Station at 2:17—but the rain is frozen and the city has been repeating the same hundred minutes for seventeen years. The trapped residents still age. The outside world forgets them.

A radio signal leads Tara through the underground market to Imran, the brother who vanished when she was a baby. He recognizes her red headphone cable. Before they can understand the reunion, every clock jumps backward—and the loop becomes one minute shorter.
